_note: DEC-113/DEC-117 Standard-tier speed regression, re-anchored to LABELED TRUTH (2026-11-01). Compares the engine's `speed_avg_foul_to_pins` (full-lane average, foul_cross -> first head-pin contact, 59.44 ft) to Shayne's labeled truth from validation/labels/pin_anchor_truth.json (truth_mph = 59.44 / (first_pin_contact_s - foul_cross_s)), NOT old engine output. This is the apples-to-apples comparison: the labels measure the foul->pins average, and so does speed_avg_foul_to_pins (DEC-064/DEC-112). A CV change that moves the engine CLOSER to truth now PASSES instead of being flagged + bypassed. WHY the metric changed from `ball_speed`: the headline `ball_speed` is the EARLY-LANE (release) speed (reversed to DEC-030 by Shayne 2026-10-29), which is physically higher than the full-lane average and has NO labeled ground truth, so it was never truth-comparable (release-vs-avg offset was +0.76/-0.11/+0.44/+0.87 on 8751-54). The release headline is kept per clip as `baseline_ball_speed` for drift visibility only (not gated). tol_mph 0.5 = the DEC-034 beta accuracy bar; the engine's foul->pins average tracks truth to MAE ~0.12 (max 0.28), so this passes with margin and still catches a real regression.
